# Screenshots or Artifacts

Add screenshots, PDF/deckpkg links, visual diffs, or package artifact links when the change affects UI, rendering, export, presenter, or packaging behavior.

# Breaking Changes

- [ ] No breaking changes

# Security and Data Boundaries

- [ ] No API keys, provider tokens, private deck content, or logs with secrets are committed

- [ ] Project-boundary behavior is unchanged or covered by tests
